package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	redis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

// scenario for redis_connection_per_request: `redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{...})` inside handler/request functions
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func scenario423Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	rdb := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
		Addr:     "localhost:6379",
		Password: "",
		DB:       0,
	})
	defer rdb.Close()

	if err := rdb.Ping(r.Context()).Err(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	_ = context.Background()
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
